long_biography.plain_text:
As a stylist and salon owner, Carolyn Aronson spent two decades combining several products to serve different hair types. The frustration led her to develop a single multipurpose leave-in conditioner. After an earlier line failed, she and a partner started It’s a 10 with $80,000 and introduced its first product through professional stylists.

Aronson grew the range deliberately and with little debt, using salon relationships and product sampling before expanding distribution. In 2017 she financed the purchase of her partner’s stake, repaid that borrowing within three years and kept the company private. She remains sole owner and chief executive while extending the business into cosmetics, men’s grooming and acquired haircare brands. Sales generated by those brands belong to the companies; Aronson’s personal interest is her ownership stake.
